No core changes, generic lease construction, force push, provider launch or CI.
Unknown/submitted attempts are observed, never resubmitted by this adapter.
"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/adopt2121-20261008')

import consumer_adoption as adoption
import execution_lease_v2 as lease
import managed_host_bridge as bridge
import operation_intent as operation
from git_document_store import GitDocumentStore
from git_remote_identity import remote_identity


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def save(path, document):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')


def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=repo, text=True, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).strip()


def verify_reviews(name, candidate):
    acceptance = read(ROOT / 'ordered-review-acceptance.json')
    # This record is populated only from the owner's actual acceptance messages.
    assert acceptance['owner_explicitly_accepted'] is True
    assert acceptance['candidates'][name] == candidate
    assert acceptance['ordered_roles'] == ['SPEC', 'QUALITY']
    for role in acceptance['ordered_roles']:
        proof = acceptance['reviews'][role]
        assert proof['conclusion'] == 'GREEN'
        subprocess.run(['git', 'fetch', '--no-tags', proof['remote'], proof['ref']],
                       cwd=proof['repo_root'], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', proof['commit'] + ':' + proof['path']],
                                       cwd=proof['repo_root'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == proof['sha256']
        assert len(data) == proof['utf8_bytes']
    # The QUALITY acceptance must bind the actual operational source being run.
    for filename, expected in acceptance['operational_source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
    for filename, expected in acceptance['external_source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
    assert '/workspace/work/normalize2121-adapter/budget-update.py' in acceptance['external_source_sha256']
    assert 'publish-consumer-live.py' in acceptance['operational_source_sha256']
    return acceptance


def main(name):
    assert name in {'gpc', 'switcher', 'gad'}
    root = ROOT / (name + '-adapter')
    request, handle = read(root / 'start-request.json'), read(root / 'start-receipt.json')
    preparation = read(root / 'preparation.json')
    state = read(root / 'consumer-publication-state.json')
    accepted = verify_reviews(name, preparation['candidate'])
    assert read(root / 'strict-package-verification.json')['matched'] is True
    repo = request['repo_root']

    session, runtime, store = bridge._recover_session(request['handle_root'], handle['handle_id'])
    observed = runtime.observe(request['task_id'], request['attempt_id'])
    assert observed['status'] == 'awaiting_release' and observed['pending_terminal_status'] == 'succeeded'
    assert session.get('publication') is None, 'Existing publication needs read-only recovery, not replay'
    bridge._renew_for_result(session, store, observed)
    candidate, changed, _ = bridge._result(session, runtime)
    assert candidate == preparation['candidate']
    attempts = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-' + name + '-live-publication-20261008', identity)
    assembly = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', state['assembly_authority']['store_ref'], identity)

    publisher._verify_candidate(state)

    _, existing = attempts.read()

               'backend': 'native_git', 'mode': 'ATOMIC_CONSUMER_ADOPTION',
               'environment_id': 'cloud-continuation-a1',
               'check_suite_fingerprint': operation._hash(accepted),
               'environment_fingerprint': operation._hash({'source_identity': identity}),
               'check_plan_digest': operation._hash(state)}
    intent = operation.prepare(binding, request['attempt_id'] + '-live-a1', request['lease_source_ref'], now())
    intents = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-' + name + '-live-operation-20261008', identity)
    ir, prior = intents.read()
    assert ir is None, 'Unknown submission never replay'
    ir = intents.compare_and_swap(None, intent)
    rr, actual = intents.read()
    assert rr == ir
    receipt = operation.verify_readback(intent, actual, 'git:' + ir + ':document.json', now())
    intent = operation.transition(intent, 'submitting', now(), receipt=receipt)
    ir = intents.compare_and_swap(ir, intent)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('budget_update', '/workspace/work/normalize2121-adapter/budget-update.py')
    budget_update = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(budget_update)
    wake = 'cloud-adopt2121-20261008'

             'task_id': 'cdc-parallel-maintenance', 'wake_id': wake, 'at_utc': now(),
             'kind': 'tool_call', 'operation_key': intent['operation_key'],
             'attempt_id': intent['attempt_id'], 'scope': 'atomic-consumer-adoption/' + name,
             'recovery_ref': None, 'cost': {'tool_calls': 1, 'tokens': None, 'elapsed_seconds': None}}
    budget_revision = budget_update.update([event], wake, str(root / 'live-publication-budget.json'))

    verify_reviews(name, candidate)
    assert git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', request['lease_source_ref']).split()[0] == preparation['base']
    assert git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'canonical', 'refs/heads/release/v2.12.1').split()[0] == state['target_release_commit']

    live = bridge.observe({'schema': 'managed-host-observe/v1', 'handle_root': request['handle_root'], 'handle_id': handle['handle_id']})
    assert live['lease_owned'] and live['runtime_status'] == 'awaiting_release'
    assert git('/workspace/g-cdc', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/parallel-maintenance-budget-20261007').split()[0] == budget_revision
    lr, record = store.read()
    lease.check_record(record, handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], now(), action='external_start', intent_digest=operation._hash(intent))
    claim = lease.claim_submission(store, lr, request['lease_repository'], request['lease_source_ref'], handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], now(), intent_digest=operation._hash(intent))
    save(root / 'live-publication-grant.json', claim)
    publication = publisher.publish(state)
    save(root / 'consumer-native-publication.json', publication)
    assert publication['action'] in {'CONFIRMED', 'CONFIRMED_FROM_READBACK'}, 'Do not replay uncertain/rejected submission'
    assert publication['conditional_update'] and publication['published_head'] == candidate
    assert publication['package_tree'] == state['target_package_tree']
    journal_revision, journal = attempts.read()
    publication['evidence_ref'] = 'git:' + journal_revision + ':document.json'
    terminal_task = {'task_id': candidate, 'task_url': 'https://github.com/' + request['lease_repository'] + '/tree/' + candidate,
                     'operation_key': intent['operation_key'], 'attempt_id': intent['attempt_id'], 'binding': intent['binding'],
                     'state': 'terminal', 'conclusion': 'succeeded', 'evidence_refs': [publication['evidence_ref']]}
    observation = {'schema': 'operation-observation/v1', 'operation_key': intent['operation_key'], 'lookup_complete': True,
                   'observed_at_utc': now(), 'tasks': [terminal_task]}
    lr, record = store.read()
    store.compare_and_swap(lr, lease.clear_guard(record, handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], now(), observation, publication['evidence_ref']))
    ir, actual = intents.read()
    intents.compare_and_swap(ir, operation.transition(actual, 'terminal', now(), task=terminal_task))
    # The session contains the real specialized publisher's receipt, never a local assertion of publication.
    session.update(state='published', worker_status='succeeded', result_commit=candidate, publication=publication)
    bridge._save_session(session)
    task = next(t for t in request['plan']['tasks'] if t['id'] == request['task_id'])
    finish = {'schema': 'managed-host-finish/v1', 'handle_root': request['handle_root'], 'handle_id': handle['handle_id'],
              'output_refs': task['expected_outputs'], 'evidence_refs': task['expected_evidence'],
              'checkpoint_ref': publication['evidence_ref']}
    receipt = bridge.finish(finish)
    save(root / 'finish-receipt.json', receipt)
    assert receipt['scope_complete'] and receipt['state'] == 'released'
    supervisor = runtime.observe(request['task_id'], request['attempt_id'])
    save(root / 'supervisor-terminal.json', supervisor)
    assert supervisor['quiescent'] is True
    lr, record = store.read()
    assert record['owner_id'] is None and record['external_guard'] is None
    print(json.dumps({'candidate': candidate, 'journal_revision': journal_revision, 'finish': receipt}))

    main(sys.argv[1])
